opportunities.title: Small Grants – UK Office
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution that is willing to receive grant funds; applications from individuals are not accepted unless organisational support is shown.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding to enable UK‑Japan collaborative projects across arts, culture, humanities, social issues, Japanese language, medicine and health, science, youth, education and sport, fostering mutual understanding and lasting collaboration.

opportunities.title: Small Grants – Japan Office
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution that is willing to receive grant funds; applications from individuals are not accepted unless organisational support is shown.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding to enable UK‑Japan collaborative projects across arts, culture, humanities, social issues, Japanese language, medicine and health, science, youth, education and sport, fostering mutual understanding and lasting collaboration.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in Medicine and Health

amount.raw: up to £10,000 per year, up to £30,000 total

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants should normally have an existing research record; early‑career practitioners, managers or carers in health‑related fields are welcomed. Projects must involve partners in both the UK and Japan and be centred on medicine and health.
opportunities.summary: Annual awards supporting exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK, covering travel, conference and publication costs, up to three‑year projects.
